title: Bronco Concert Goes On in Nuevo Laredo, but Saturday's Cabalgata Is Suspended Over Rain
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo confirmed Bronco plays Saturday at 8 p.m. at Polyforum La Fe, but the cabalgata is suspended over the rain forecast.
content:
Grupo Bronco's concert in Nuevo Laredo will go on as planned Saturday night — but the horseback ride scheduled for the same day will not.

Nuevo Laredo Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal announced Friday that the cabalgata set for Saturday, Nov. 14, is suspended as a precaution because of the rain forecast. The Bronco concert is confirmed for 8 p.m. Saturday at Polyforum La Fe, with no changes.

The mayor explained that although heavy rain is not expected, moisture on the pavement poses a risk to riders, especially on the bridges and grades along the route. The decision followed recommendations from the rider associations, who said a completely dry surface is needed to avoid slips and possible accidents during the ride.

"This determination responds to a prevention measure, prioritizing at all times the safety of families and of those who would participate in this activity," Canturosas Villarreal said, according to local reports.

A big weekend across the river

The announcement lands in a busy week for Nuevo Laredo. The city's DIF system just celebrated 89 couples in its second mass-wedding event of 2026 — part of a program that has helped 634 couples formalize their marriages free of charge since October 2021 — and the municipal government is holding a job fair, "Empleo en tu Colonia," on Friday at Soriana Carrizo, along with free training for entrepreneurs Friday afternoon.

For Laredoans planning to cross for the Bronco show, the message is simple: the concert is on, the ride is off, and the city is asking everyone to plan around the wet roads.
